title: Entity
description: A node in the biographical graph: a person, place, organization, or named artifact (invention/patent/product/publication).

id.description: Stable snake_case id, unique within entities.json.

aliases.description: Other names/spellings this entity is referred to by in sources.

summary.description: 1–3 sentence static description. Facts here are NOT events — no dates, no 'in 1974...' clauses.

subtype.description: Free-text refinement, e.g. person: 'researcher'; place: 'city'/'country'/'facility'; organization: 'company'/'university'/'lab'; artifact: 'invention'/'patent'/'product'/'publication'/'award'.

attributes.description: Optional structured extras (e.g. { "country": "Finland" } for a place).

portrait.description: A verified photo, only for entity_type 'person'. Never hand-picked from an image search — see schema/README.md § Portraits for the required verification steps before adding one.

image_url.description: Direct, hotlinkable image URL (e.g. a Wikimedia Commons Special:FilePath link). Loaded live by the viewer's browser at render time — never embedded as a data URI.

source_url.description: Page a reader can open to verify the photo and its licensing (e.g. the Commons file page).

wikidata_qid.description: Wikidata item id the photo and identity claims were verified against, if applicable.

confidence.description: How identity was confirmed: 'birth_year_verified' = the candidate's Wikidata birth date matches a birth event already in this subject's events.json; 'description_verified' = no independent date to check, but the Wikidata description/occupation is specific enough to match this entity's role in the source (e.g. exact nationality + profession + era); 'unverified' must not be used to add a portrait — treat it as 'no match' instead.
